description: Fetches a page and checks it against the W3C Web Sustainability Guidelines. Returns the score, grade, and each failed or warned check with a recommended fix. Local URLs such as http://localhost:3000 are fetched from the user's machine; they work unless the server was started with --no-local.

categories.description: WSG categories to run. Defaults to all three.

detail.description: "summary" (default) returns the score and the failed or warned checks. "full" also returns the complete report, which is much longer.

guidelines.description: Narrow the run to these guideline slugs (e.g. "minify-and-remove-unused-code") or related-check IDs.

timeoutMs.description: Give up after this many milliseconds. Defaults to 60000.

url.description: The page to check, e.g. https://example.com or http://localhost:3000

name: check_url

report.description: The complete report; present only when detail is "full"

carbon.description: Estimated from the HTML size only; absent fields were not measured

finalUrl.description: The URL actually fetched, after redirects

issues.description: Failed and warned checks: WSG checks first, then by impact, failures first

related.description: true for related checks, which are reported but not scored

notices.description: Notes about the request, e.g. deprecated guideline IDs

specVersion.description: The WSG release the checks were scored against

title: Check a URL against the WSG
